overall_notes: The paper is about text-to-audio generation using rectified flow models. It uses both automatic metrics (FAD, KL Divergence, CLAP Score, RTF) and human evaluation (MOS-Q for quality, MOS-F for alignment) to evaluate generated audio. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of dataset names and consolidation of redundant metric listings.
